title: Describe resources and access ranges
scope: Define common device-owned resource identities and read/write ranges at dispatch boundaries.
acceptance: A mock adapter observes typed bindings and complete indirect resource references.
Overlap, aliasing and out-of-range uses have explicit rules and tests.
evidence: PASS: cmake --build build-gallery-portable-verify --target parallel-mater-compute-contract-tests and ctest -R ^parallel-mater-compute-contract-tests$; portable mock adapter observed named binding kinds, exact byte ranges, access modes, and complete indirect references.

PASS: Apple M4 native Metal driver build and parallel-mater-slang-metal-kernel-tests; 143 reflected pipelines plus dispatch, transfers, nested records, rigid integration, soft-body SIMD, and AVBD execution passed.
PASS: docs/COMMON-RESOURCE-BOUNDARY.md specifies device-scoped alias identity, half-open overlap rules, conservative default extents, null handling, and out-of-range rejection.
